Dear Qargo team,

I'm applying for the UI/UX Designer role in Ghent. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've spent years building and refining websites where clarity, consistency, and usability directly impact results. I've designed and built sites like baverok.com and mirook.com from the ground up, hand-coding accessible markup and structured data, and I've created consistent layouts for large-scale projects such as a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles.

I use Claude and other AI tools daily to speed up research, content, and prototyping, and I have hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I'm eager to bring this mix of design sensibility and technical understanding to Qargo's design system, working closely with product and engineering teams.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your platform.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm writing to apply for the UI/UX Designer position in Ghent. While my background is in digital marketing and web development, I've always been drawn to the visual and structural side of digital products—how a well-designed system makes complex information feel simple. At Qargo, you're looking for someone to own and evolve a design system from the ground up, and I believe my hands-on experience building and maintaining websites with a strong focus on consistency and usability makes me a strong fit.

In my freelance work, I designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com from scratch, hand-coding accessible markup and structured data. For mirook.com, I implemented JSON-LD schema and ran iterative technical audits to improve search health. At Episto, I built and maintained a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages on a pharmacists' association site, and I've designed Shopify stores and WordPress sites for various clients. These projects required me to think carefully about hierarchy, clarity, and consistency—skills that are directly transferable to design system work.

I use Claude and other AI tools daily to speed up research, content, and prototyping, and I have practical knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This technical fluency helps me collaborate effectively with engineers and understand the constraints of front-end implementation. I'm comfortable working with dense, complex interfaces and have experience with Figma and other design tools.

I'm excited by the opportunity to be Qargo's first dedicated designer, to engage directly with customers, and to build a design system that engineering and product teams can rely on. I'm fluent in English and based in Belgium, and I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
